analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the marking export correctly and applies Regulation 14 the way examination boards read question difficulty, each question's mean mark among the candidates who answered it set against the paper's mean, moves the new building-fire-safety question down because its choosers scored well and the plain planning question up because its choosers scored poorly, and files the wrong pass count; the stronger candidates chose the hard question and the weaker the easy one, so only each question's difficulty read on the same candidates across the questions they chose gives the regulation's adjustments.
domain_test: Assessment practice sets optional questions on one scale by reading each question's difficulty from the answers given to it, and examinee choice is the case where the candidates answering a question are not the cohort, so a question's facility mixes its difficulty with its choosers' standing; with another field's nouns there is no optional question, no choice of five from eight and no mark scale for the adjustment to move.

world.geography: Australia (a fictional national professional institute of building certifiers)
world.org_type: professional institute running the accreditation examination for building certifiers

driver: Each unit answers a few of several alternative items it chooses itself, and the items differ in difficulty while the units choosing each differ in standing, so an item's mean outcome mixes its difficulty with its choosers' standing; the difficulty for the whole population is read by comparing the same units across the items they chose, and correcting by the mean outcome moves the hardest item the wrong way.
driver_concrete: The November 2026 paper's new building-fire-safety question was chosen mostly by the strongest candidates and the plain planning-approvals question by the weakest, so the fire question's mean mark is the paper's highest while every candidate who answered it scored less on it than on their other questions; read on the same candidates across the questions they chose, the fire question is the hardest and the planning question the easiest, and Regulation 14's whole-mark adjustments follow from that, not from the means.
stump: A competent analyst sets each question's mean mark among those who answered it against the paper's mean, lowers the fire-safety question and raises the planning question, and files a pass count that credits the weaker candidates who chose the easy question and docks the stronger who chose the hard one; the step that lands it there is reading a question's facility as its difficulty when its choosers are not the cohort.

lineage.architecture: v1 (a regional council of governments splitting its 2027 weatherization fund across fourteen member counties by working families with children claiming the earned income credit, from IRS ZIP-code tables)
lineage.fate: re-rooted 2026-11-01 at the Batch 3 queue reset (shipped 2026-10-20 with no portal result; world closed, one architecture per world)
lineage.driver: A subtotal of one kind of member inside each area's published total is never published, but each area's total comes with a paired amount and the kinds carry known and very different average amounts, so an area's own count and amount fix its mix; applying the region-wide share of the kind to every area misplaces the subtotal wherever an area's mix departs from the region's, and a cap that binds only on the overstated area moves every other share.
lineage.driver_concrete: The council allocates by earned income credit returns with qualifying children, which the IRS ZIP-code tables do not split; in the lowest AGI class, the only one where childless workers claim, each county's claims count and credit amount together fix how many are families, because a childless worker's credit averages a few hundred dollars against several thousand for a family; the statewide share overstates the seat county, whose many young childless workers pull its average credit down, and caps it at 12 per cent instead of leaving it below the cap.
lineage.stump: The default path applies the statewide share of claimants with children in each AGI class to every county's credit claims and caps the seat county at 12 per cent, because it never asks what each county's own credit amounts say about its mix of families and childless workers.

notes: Client domain education-learning-sciences, task type item-response-theory-test-equating (ETL, DD): putting optional questions on one scale is equating within a paper. stump_strategy population_selection: each question's answerers are a population selected on standing, and the decisive move reads the question's difficulty for the whole sitting rather than for its choosers.
